Subject: Grounding & RAG pilot scope — recommended models, retrieval settings, next steps

Hi Claire — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call so we have alignment before we spin up a lightweight pilot.

Call highlights:
- Goal: improve answer grounding for clinician-facing Q&A over LumenHealth’s internal clinical KB (policies + curated literature). Priorities are high precision and low hallucination; latency target <= 600ms median for single-turn queries.
- Constraints: PHI-sensitive (customer will anonymize for pilot), retention policy limited to 30 days, strict audit logs required.
- Volume: expected steady-state ~3–8K queries/day with peak bursts for cohort analysis.

Proposed RAG pilot (high level):
1) Models to evaluate (parallel arms):
   - Candidate A: Redwood-3.1-opt (quantized 8-bit, balanced cost-latency)
   - Candidate B: Llama-3-7B-q4f (fast, lower cost)
   - Candidate C: Open-gen large (20B class) for reference-quality scoring on dev set only
2) Retrieval & reranking: dense embeddings (redwood-embed-14k) for recall + a cross-encoder reranker for final grounding score.
3) Metrics to track: grounding precision@1, hallucination incidence (manual spot-checks), MRR@5, latency p50/p95, token cost per query.
4) Data & eval: we’ll use the prompt_set_v2.jsonl you mentioned + an initial benchmark of 250 golden prompts (we included an initial CSV outline).
5) Timeline: 2-week pilot deploy -> 1-week focused eval/report.

Action items I/O:
- LumenHealth: share anonymized prompt set (you mentioned a 2k sample) and confirm retention/audit requirements in writing.
- Redwood: provide a pilot config (models + retrieval settings), benchmark run, and a short eval rubric for your legal/infosec review.

I attached a starter benchmark CSV and the prompt set we discussed (stubs). Rishi — I copied you for the config + reranker options. Monica — looping you for the commercial pilot estimate.

Looking forward — happy to adjust based on anything I missed.

Best,
Ava Chen
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Claire — quick technical reply and plan for the deliverables you requested.

Reranker strategy (short):
- We recommend a two-stage approach: bi-encoder retrieval (dense embeddings) -> candidate set (top 50) -> cross-encoder reranker to score candidates for grounding precision. The bi-encoder gives fast recall; the cross-encoder gives final precision for the answer displayed to clinicians.
- Reranker model: Redwood-cross-encoder-1.0 (fine-tuned on grounding pairs) or, if you want an open alternative, cross-encoder-xl (xformers-backed). We will produce a small calibration set so you can pick a threshold.

Retrieval settings (initial):
- Embedding model: redwood-embed-14k (high-dim dense)
- Index: HNSW with ef_search=128 for p95 latency balance
- Preprocessing: clinical phrase normalization + acronym expansion (we supply a pipeline)
- Candidate pool: top_k=50; reranker_top_k=5 to compute grounding precision@1 and MRR@5.

Grounding & evaluation metrics (automatable + manual):
- Grounding precision@1 (automated check: answer provenance token overlap with top doc URI)
- Hallucination incidence: automated flags (low provenance overlap, model confidence mismatch) + 10% manual spot-checks for gold labeling
- MRR@5, Recall@50, latency (p50/p95), cost per query (tokens + reranker cycles)
- Regression monitoring: baseline snapshot will be stored; we’ll run diff-evals on any model/quantization change and flag >2% absolute drop in grounding precision.

Model candidates & the use-case tradeoffs:
- Redwood-3.1-opt: best balance for production cost and grounding quality when paired with cross-encoder reranker (recommended as primary pilot arm).
- Llama-3-7B-q4f: lower cost, lower single-turn quality; good for a fast baseline to tune retrieval.
- Open-gen large (20B): use as an offline scoring/reference model for quality ceiling — expensive to run live.

Deliverables we’ll send by EOD tomorrow:
- 20 example prompt outputs across the three candidate models (anonymized)
- Pilot config JSON (retrieval + reranker params) and a short runbook for audit/retention controls
- Baseline benchmark results (attached CSV) and the reranker-profiles PDF explaining scoring behavior

Cost note (rough): 2-week pilot with 5K queries/day and reranking on top-50 ~= $5k–$9k depending on cross-encoder sizing. Monica will follow up with a precise pilot quote.

If you confirm the 2-week window, we’ll provision a dedicated pilot namespace with required audit logging and a single-tenant embedding index.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
